title: Fractional CTO - Post-Acquisition IT Integration
description_md: Hearthstone Capital Partners' portfolio company just closed the acquisition of a smaller competitor (8-K disclosed) and needs a fractional CTO to lead the 90-day IT integration: system consolidation, security baseline, and a unified data platform.

title: Fractional CIO - ERP Modernization Program
description_md: Kestrel Foods Distribution just hired a new CFO (per an 8-K item 5.02 filing) who is sponsoring an ERP modernization program and needs a fractional CIO to scope and run vendor selection through go-live planning.

title: Interim CTO - Security Incident Recovery
description_md: Wrayburn Health Network disclosed a ransomware incident last month and needs an interim CTO onsite immediately to run recovery, breach remediation, and rebuild board confidence in the security program. Clear, urgent, well-funded mandate.

title: Fractional CIO - Carve-Out Separation
description_md: A PE sponsor is carving out a division of Alderman Industrial Holdings into a standalone company and needs a fractional CIO to stand up independent IT systems ahead of day-one separation from the parent's shared services.

title: Fractional CTO - Platform Rebuild Advisory
description_md: Northgate SaaS Ventures just closed a Series C (per a public funding announcement) and its board wants an outside fractional CTO to run technical due diligence on the existing platform and produce a rebuild-vs-scale roadmap before the next hire.

title: Fractional CIO - General IT Leadership
description_md: Bellcross Manufacturing wants ongoing fractional CIO coverage for steady-state IT leadership. No specific trigger event or transformation program named in the RFP; a generic, if legitimate, engagement.

title: Interim CTO - 3-Month Bridge While Search
description_md: Thistlewood Retail Group's CTO departed and they need an interim CTO for a defined 3-month bridge while a permanent search runs. Clear scope, short and fixed duration.

title: Fractional CTO - Advisory Board Seat
description_md: Corvale Biotech, an early-stage biotech, wants light-touch fractional CTO advisory: a few hours a month reviewing the informatics roadmap. Real but very thin scope and correspondingly modest pay, right at the margin.

title: Fractional CIO - Compliance Program Stand-up
description_md: Millbrook Credit Union needs a fractional CIO to stand up a formal IT governance and compliance program ahead of its next NCUA exam cycle. Well-defined, moderate-scope engagement.

title: Interim CIO - Post-Layoff IT Stabilization
description_md: Redshaw Logistics filed an 8-K disclosing a workforce reduction that included half the IT department. They need an interim CIO to stabilize operations, but the RFP is vague on budget and duration -- a genuinely borderline read.

title: Fractional CTO - Vendor Consolidation Project
description_md: Ashford Municipal Services wants a fractional CTO to consolidate a sprawl of legacy vendor contracts into a smaller, better-governed set. Public-sector pace, clear and bounded scope.

title: Fractional CIO - Data Center Exit Planning
description_md: Greymoor Insurance Group wants a fractional CIO to plan and execute an exit from its last on-premises data center to cloud infrastructure. Strong, well-scoped engagement just short of the clearest pursues.

title: Fractional CTO - Unpaid Advisory / Equity-Only
description_md: Fable Games Studio, a pre-seed gaming startup, offers a fractional CTO advisory role compensated entirely in equity with no cash day rate and no defined term.

title: Interim CIO - Full-Time-in-Disguise Role
description_md: Brackenfield Retail's 'interim CIO' posting actually wants five-day-a-week, open-ended, full-time-equivalent hours at a contractor day rate with no fractional structure at all -- a mismatched engagement type.

title: Fractional CTO - Below-Market Day Rate
description_md: Oldstone Nonprofit Alliance is seeking a fractional CTO at a day rate well below the market floor for the scope of work described, effectively subsidized nonprofit pricing.

title: Fractional CIO - Generic Recruiter RFP
description_md: A generic fractional CIO RFP posted by a staffing intermediary on behalf of an undisclosed client, reposted across multiple boards with no company detail, no comp range, and no way to verify legitimacy. Ghost-RFP profile.

title: Interim CTO - Distressed Company
description_md: Vantage Hardware Co disclosed a going-concern warning in its latest filing. They want an interim CTO, but the company's ability to pay for the engagement past 60 days is genuinely in doubt -- a real financial-risk flag, not a quality problem.

title: Fractional CIO - Scope Creep at Contractor Pay
description_md: Bramwell School District's fractional CIO RFP describes what is really a full-time-equivalent workload (district-wide systems, security, and helpdesk oversight) at a fractional contractor rate.

title: Fractional CTO - Competitor Conflict of Interest
description_md: Ridgeline Analytics is a direct competitor to a firm the operator already advises under an exclusivity clause. Otherwise a reasonable fractional CTO engagement, but a genuine conflict-of-interest dealbreaker.

title: Interim CIO - Requires Full Relocation
description_md: Fenwick Global Manufacturing's interim CIO engagement is well-scoped and well-paid, but requires full relocation to an onsite-only plant location outside any workable geography, with no remote or hybrid option.
